detailed_description:
The video follows a warm, cinematic style with soft focus and high-fidelity textures, capturing an intimate moment in a retro diner.

[Shot 1] The shot begins as a continuous medium shot in a vibrant diner matching <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> sits on the left side of the red leather booth, smiling toward <Subject 2>. <Subject 2>, sitting on the right, looks down at a tray of French fries on the beige table. In the center, <Subject 3> stands between the two, holding a menu with a neutral expression. Rain streaks the large glass window behind them, reflecting the warm interior. <Subject 2> reaches forward and picks up <Subject 4> from the table. With a smooth, steady movement, she uncaps the tube and brings it to the dark, reflective surface of the window glass. Using the window as a makeshift mirror, she carefully glides the coral bullet across her lips. As she applies the color, <Subject 1> turns her head to observe, while <Subject 3> watches with a professional, curious gaze. The camera executes a smooth, handheld-style truck to the right at a medium-to-slow speed, keeping the three subjects in a balanced composition while subtly enhancing the parallax of the rain on the glass. <Subject 2> gently presses her lips together and holds the look, a subtle smile forming on her face.
